key_insight: Cold spray enables solid-state deposition of metals and composites, making it highly attractive for damage repair and additive manufacturing with reduced oxidation, distortion, and residual stress.
engineering_relevance: The review highlights cold spray as a practical pathway for high-integrity component restoration and complex part fabrication in industries that need strong microstructural and mechanical performance.
method: Surveyed recent cold spray coatings, deposits, and repair/use cases
Compared processing of current and emerging metals/alloys for cold spray
Reviewed cold spray additive manufacturing strategies, including layer-by-layer and gradient structures
evidence_signal: The paper synthesizes published advances and application trends rather than presenting a new experimental dataset, with emphasis on industrial requirements, monitoring, and predictive modeling.
watch_item: Industrial adoption still depends on improved in situ monitoring, predictive models, and standardized qualification protocols for reliable part acceptance.
paper_title: Advances in Cold Spray for Repair and Additive Manufacturing: A Review
